blocks.text: Sab kimiyai reactions mein naye bonds banne se pehle reactant molecules ke bonds tootte hain, jo sirf tab ho sakta hai jab reactant molecules energy ki rukawat (barrier) par qaboo pane ke liye kaafi energy se takrayein.

blocks.title: Activation energy
blocks.text: Reactant molecules ko energy ki rukawat paar karne ke liye darkar kam se kam energy activation energy, Ea, hai.

blocks.alt: Reaction ki pesh-raft ke muqable enthalpy ke do graphs. Baen surkh curve reactants se ek ubhar ke oopar uth kar neeche products tak girta hai, ubhar ki choti tak Ea aur delta H ke liye neeche ka teer nishan-zada. Daen neela curve bare ubhar ke oopar se reactants se oonche products tak jata hai, oopar ke delta H teer ke saath.
blocks.caption: Exothermic aur endothermic reaction ke energy profile diagrams delta H aur Ea ke saath (Figures 6.1 aur 6.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Dono diagrams mein reactants ko products tak girne se pehle rukawat ki choti tak charhna hai, jo activation energy Ea leta hai. Exothermic soorat mein products reactants se neeche hain, to delta H manfi hai aur hararat kharij hoti hai; endothermic soorat mein products reactants se oopar hain, to delta H musbat hai aur hararat jazb hoti hai, aur rukawat delta H se bari hai. Ubhar ki oonchai Ea hai aur dono sathon ka farq delta H.

blocks.prompt: CH4 + 2O2 se CO2 + 2H2O (delta H = -890.3 kJ fi mol) aur CaCO3 se CaO + CO2 (delta H = +572 kJ fi mol) ke energy profile diagrams bayan karein.
blocks.explanation: Methane ka jalna: reactant satah oonchi hai, curve ubhar (Ea) ke oopar uth kar 890.3 kJ fi mol neeche product satah tak girta hai, exothermic profile. Limestone ka tootna: reactant satah neechi hai, curve ubhar ke oopar uth kar 572 kJ fi mol oonchi product satah par khatam hota hai, endothermic profile jis mein Ea kam se kam 572 kJ fi mol hona chahiye.

items: Naye bonds banne se pehle bonds tootne hain, to reactants ko rukawat paar karne ke liye activation energy Ea chahiye; profile Ea ko ubhar aur delta H ko reactants se products tak girawat (exothermic) ya charhai (endothermic) ke taur par dikhata hai.
